Name: Stream Deck Agents
Author: Drew Ritter

Actions.Name: Session Grid
Actions.Tooltip: Shows live agent sessions; press Claude, Codex, or Kimi tiles to focus or open them.

Description: Displays live agent sessions from the local registry on a 15-key grid. Press Claude tiles to focus their Ghostty terminals, Codex tiles to open desktop tasks, and Kimi tiles to open Web sessions.
